text: ねえ　シゲ…　もし　かてたら　けっこん　して　あげる！

structure.jp: けっこん　して　あげる！

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.explanation: あげる after a て-form verb says you do the thing as a favor for the other person. けっこん　して　あげる = 'I'll marry you (as a treat for you)'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' that happens; もし in front makes the 'if' clear from the start. もし　かてたら = 'if you manage to win'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing かつ to かてる turns 'win' into 'can win'. かてたら = 'if you can win'.
